concept: Recognizing manipulation or coercive control in a close adult relationship (romantic, family, business)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic pattern of behavior in a close relationship that, viewed individually, seems minor, but forms a pattern of control when seen together
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does it look like to step back and see a pattern rather than just isolated incidents?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies what a realistic first step toward addressing the pattern would look like

assessment.success_marker: adult identifies the pattern (not just a single incident) and a genuinely actionable first step
